nodes.label: SEBI BRSR Reporting Format (Annexure 1)
nodes.source_file: ps_documents/provided_docs/Business responsibility and sustainability reporting by listed entitiesAnnexure1_p.pdf
nodes.author: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
nodes.rationale: Prescribed standardized reporting template for listed entities under Regulation 34(2)(f) of LODR Regulations.

nodes.label: BRSR Section A: General Disclosures
nodes.source_file: ps_documents/provided_docs/Business responsibility and sustainability reporting by listed entitiesAnnexure1_p.pdf
nodes.author: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
nodes.rationale: Captures corporate identity, product/service breakdown, operating locations, employee and worker diversity, CSR details, and transparency compliance.

nodes.label: BRSR Section B: Management and Process Disclosures
nodes.source_file: ps_documents/provided_docs/Business responsibility and sustainability reporting by listed entitiesAnnexure1_p.pdf
nodes.author: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
nodes.rationale: Evaluates corporate policies mapped across 9 NGRBC principles, board oversight, ESG director responsibility, and governance processes.

nodes.label: BRSR Section C: Principle-Wise Performance Disclosures
nodes.source_file: ps_documents/provided_docs/Business responsibility and sustainability reporting by listed entitiesAnnexure1_p.pdf
nodes.author: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
nodes.rationale: Detailed quantitative and qualitative metrics for Principles 1 to 9 split into mandatory Essential and voluntary Leadership indicators.

nodes.label: BRSR Essential Indicators
nodes.source_file: ps_documents/provided_docs/Business responsibility and sustainability reporting by listed entitiesAnnexure1_p.pdf
nodes.author: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
nodes.rationale: Baseline mandatory indicators including energy consumption, water intensity, Scope 1/2 GHG emissions, waste management, and employee safety.

nodes.label: BRSR Leadership Indicators
nodes.source_file: ps_documents/provided_docs/Business responsibility and sustainability reporting by listed entitiesAnnexure1_p.pdf
nodes.author: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
nodes.rationale: Aspirational metrics such as Scope 3 emissions, life cycle assessments (LCA), biodiversity impact, and extended supplier sustainability assessments.
